rationale: Sam's expertise in software tooling for autonomous vehicle development at Applied Intuition complements Suvasis's work building robotics and autonomous systems at Adaboost—there's clear domain overlap in autonomous systems where Sam's integration focus could be valuable for Suvasis's technical stack (Python, Go, C++). This is a chance for them to explore how AV-specific tooling might apply to broader autonomous systems work.
intro_message: Sam Morstein, meet Suvasis Mukherjee — you're both working in autonomous systems from different angles (AV tooling vs. robotics/drone software), and your backgrounds could spark useful ideas on integration and system architecture.
